remaining_contract_closure.requirement: Freeze exact packaged immutable seed bytes/SHA/schema/rows/version and logical path;0700 parents/0600 seed. Runtime permits only closed validation SQL plus BEGIN IMMEDIATE/ROLLBACK; no SQL writes, PRAGMA mutations, ATTACH, extension, VACUUM, checkpoint, journal recovery or alternate DB. Refuse unsupported filesystems/locking.

Freeze two separately confirmed bootstrap stages: exact seed/directory precursor first, then exact issuer bytes bound to actual stable database/directory identities. Define absent/precursor-only/issuer-published crash/retry states; cancellation after precursor leaves only inert owned seed and no key/grant. Foreign or malformed preexisting state refuses; never rename/unlink database.

No-write and preconfirmation paths perform no writable SQLite access. Reject all journal/WAL/SHM sidecars before opening. Fresh actual authority and the appropriate exact confirmation precede seed publication or writable kernel-lock connection. Runtime has no hot-journal recovery authority.

Read exact seed hash before opening SQLite. While connection lives, no raw DB opens/closes or second connection: in-lock closed SQL schema/row validation and metadata-only lstat binding only. Callback is synchronous/non-reentrant, serialized in process, cannot escape connection/Promise. A held-readonly-fd alternative needs separate exact lifetime proof before adoption.

Database rollback must not erase signed immutable intent/consumption truth while domain files survived. Define authoritative phase/grant chain and exact restart reconciliation; native admission is not an independent grant.

Freeze domain strings, raw-byte versus canonical-payload digests, exact UTF8/base64 key encoding, closed schema variants, lossless decimal inode/birthtime fields, clock units/source and cross-process monotonic/boot identity.

Freeze all five approve modes exact argv/expected-digest/plan obligations and public cancellation/error envelopes. Current action-output.ts399-437 only admits P1 init-bind review kind/target; a new owner stream cannot use it implicitly.

Explicitly define filesystem trust anchor for issuer origin: actual protected resolved0700/0600 host namespace and typed-only writes. A MAC co-located with its own key is not independently authenticated against arbitrary same-UID filesystem replacement; either exclude that attacker or add an external trust anchor. Caller JSON/files/labels/ledgers remain untrusted.

Separate issuer installation observation (installed_at_head) from currently admitted action bindings. Define behavior after legitimate HEAD/package/registry/constitution/policy changes; same-scope renewal cannot silently migrate old issuer/grant scope, and automatic rotation/rewrite remains forbidden.

Private READY exposes size/hash/targets only; schema writeOnly is not a serializer guard. Validate safe projections and error causes for malformed bundle/MAC/schema, cancellation, cleanup and uncertainty; never emit private bytes/base64 or parser excerpts.
